Assessment & Plan:

1. Extensive eczema flare
   - Assessment: Atopic dermatitis flare (widespread).
   - Treatment planned:

     • Continue regular emollients: Diprobase cream and Dermol wash.

   - Prescription sent electronically to patient’s nominated Boots pharmacy.
